dataset: Atticus Open Contract Dataset (AOK Beta / CUAD v1)

split.input: preprocessor train_samples only; held-out test_samples are not loaded or scored
split.fit_scope: TF-IDF and Logistic Regression are fitted independently within each fold

metric_aggregation.mean_std: arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across five folds
metric_aggregation.per_class: per-fold precision/recall/F1 summarized as mean and sample standard deviation; support total and per-fold mean/std also included
metric_aggregation.confusion_matrix: sum of validation-fold confusion matrices; each train-side clause is predicted once out of fold

tie_breaker: lowest sample standard deviation of validation Macro F1
smallest absolute mean train-validation Macro F1 gap
